_about: Provenance and per-card contract data for the 12 delivered motion cards. 'original' records immutable staging author/source hashes (read-only); new output hashes are computed by tools/build_manifest.py into manifest.json and kept separate. Card slugs/mechanisms come from staging/INVENTORY/inventory-motion.json. Renderer source sha256 values are recomputed from the frozen copies in sources/. This file contains repo-relative locators only (no private absolute paths).

02.mechanism: metaball 融合/次级液滴延迟 2-3 帧 (流体融合)

params.schedule: liquid metaball merge + 2-3 frame secondary droplet delay (original)

02.notes: Reused: original 1920x1080 mp4 after fresh full decode (300 frames confirmed). No re-render, no scale. Media bytes are the immutable staging originals.

03.mechanism: 30°等角投影/顶面延迟 2-3 帧 (几何等轴生长)

params.schedule: growth windows FOUND_DUR=30, WALL_DUR=60, ROOF_DELAY=2, ROOF_DUR=12; camera_pan -0.30/+0.10 px/frame (original)

03.notes: Native re-render at 1920x1080 by calling frozen render_frame(n, seed) unchanged then applying integer geometry scale S=2 (x->2x, y->2y, 1px stroke->2x2 block, PIL NEAREST). Seed, growth schedule, 30-degree isometric basis and camera pan untouched. Mechanism preserved; geometry scaled. No upscaling of old video; every frame freshly rendered from the pure function.

platform.evidence: verified: 300 native frames + full decode; not a browser/WebGL native render
